name: HFTP homepage: Hospitality Financial and Technology Professionals
title: HFTP homepage: Hospitality Financial and Technology Professionals
answer: This is the homepage of Hospitality Financial and Technology Professionals, an international nonprofit association with a 70+ year history. It describes HFTP's education, events, networking, research and skill-building work, its 83 chapters worldwide, and its publications and sponsorship program. The most useful item for an AI in Hospitality reader is the mention of a strategic partnership between the Hospitality Tech EXPO and HITEC, with HITEC TOKYO to be held for the first time in Japan. The page does not itself report AI deployment research.

sections.body: HFTP publishes this page. It is the homepage or landing page of Hospitality Financial and Technology Professionals, described in the text as an international nonprofit association with a 70+ year history. Its scope is the association's professional development offer, including industry-focused education, events, networking, research and skill-building programs, plus chapters, publications and sponsorship. The text does not state a publication date. The supplied text was harvested on 2026-09-26.
sections.heading: What this source is

sections.body: The page presents HFTP as an international nonprofit association with a 70+ year history of supporting hospitality professionals through industry-focused education, events, networking opportunities, research and skill-building programs. It says there are 83 chapters worldwide, with chapters in the United States, Canada, Mexico, the Caribbean, the United Arab Emirates and India. It invites readers to help HFTP understand which professional services, educational opportunities, benefits and networking experiences are most valuable. A letter from HFTP Global president James Bina, CHAE Emeritus, CHTP Emeritus, is referenced. In the quoted excerpt, Bina says he looks forward to industry resources in development that will soon be available to members and the network at large, and remarks that the association continues to address changing business practices and provide information to help people navigate them. The page also notes that the Hospitality Tech EXPO, organized by RX Japan LLC, has entered a strategic partnership with HITEC, and that HITEC TOKYO will be held for the first time in Japan as a spe... The text cuts off there. Other items include a Mid-South Atlantic Regional Conference run by HFTP chapters in North and South Carolina and Virginia, Hotel Online as the hotel industry's longest-running online news source with a daily e-newsletter, Clubs Online with a monthly e-newsletter, and the Corporate Allied Sponsors program for promoting companies to HFTP members and industry professionals in hotels, clubs, resorts, casinos and other hospitality companies globally.
sections.heading: What it says

sections.body: The text states HFTP has a 70+ year history and 83 chapters worldwide, with chapters in the United States, Canada, Mexico, the Caribbean, the United Arab Emirates and India. It says HITEC TOKYO will be held for the first time in Japan through a strategic partnership between the Hospitality Tech EXPO, organized by RX Japan LLC, and HITEC. It describes Hotel Online as the hotel industry's longest-running online news source. It gives no AI deployment figures, no lodging AI adoption numbers and no research findings.
sections.heading: Figures and claims worth noting

sections.body: A reader following AI in hospitality would use this page mainly to identify HFTP as a hospitality finance and technology association and to see the channels it promotes, such as events, newsletters and a sponsorship program. The only technology event detail relevant to that interest is the HITEC TOKYO partnership mention. The page does not provide AI-specific evidence, case studies or deployment research, so it is not a source for understanding AI adoption in lodging. It is useful as background on an organization whose events and publications are named, but the supplied text does not support claims about HFTP hosting HITEC or tracking AI deployment research.
sections.heading: What it means for AI in Hospitality

sections.body: This is a landing page with little substantive detail. It does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning or AI deployment research. It does not state that HFTP hosts HITEC or that HITEC is the sector's largest technology exposition. It is promotional and membership-oriented, including a sponsorship program and newsletter subscriptions. It has no publication date, and one HITEC TOKYO sentence is truncated. The text is partial and not a research report.
